acceptance_results.evidence: All three seeded defects reported with correct location and mechanism: the pageWindow off-by-one (cursor stores exclusive end, next page starts at offset+1, so a [0,10) window permanently skips row 10), the check-then-act reserve race across the awaited gauge call, and the empty catch in withRetry swallowing AbortError so cancellation continues the retry loop.

Four findings. Grader verification: the three seeded defects are genuine, and the fourth (gauges keyed only by metric name while emissions include per-queue tags) is a real metric-correctness flaw already confirmed on this fixture. Zero non-defects asserted as defects.

Each finding names file and line, the concrete wrong outcome, and a specific fix (store end-1 or drop the +1; update reservation state before the first await; re-throw abort errors; include tags in the gauge key).
